comment.body:
I think you need to specify which exact rule or stealth module is causing issues to narrow down the exceptions.

In this case, looks like on my side the issue is caused by the Referrer stealth module, so the rule could be

```adblock
@@||bc4liveiframecdn.shop/player/$subdocument,stealth=referrer
```

and should be put in `allowlist_stealth.txt` file.

issue.title: www.standard-freeholder.com
issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: intercelestial.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://apps.apple.com/br/app/ludo-house/id1452973510](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapps.apple.com%2Fbr%2Fapp%2Fludo-house%2Fid1452973510) ### Comment > ### Title > Ads appearing in games after updating to iOS 27 despite DNS filtering being enabled > > ### Description > After updating to iOS 27, ads started appearing in some games even though DNS filtering is enabled in AdGuard. > > I am using **AdGuard DNS** with the **AdGuard DNS filter** enabled. Ad blocking still works well in Safari, but ads are no longer being blocked in some apps. > > One affected app is [Ludo House](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/ludo-house/id1452973510). All ads in this game appear as usual, despite all protection features being enabled in AdGuard. > > ### Steps to reproduce > 1. On a device running iOS 27, enable AdGuard protection. > 2. Configure AdGuard DNS and enable the AdGuard DNS filter. > 3. Open Ludo House and play until an ad is displayed. > > ### Expected behavior > Ads in games should continue to be blocked as they were before the iOS update. > > ### Actual behavior > Ads appear in Ludo House and some other apps, while ad blocking in Safari continues to work. > > ### Environment > - **iOS version:** 27 > - **DNS server:** AdGuard DNS > - **DNS filter:** AdGuard DNS filter > - **Example affected app:** Ludo House ``` Username: @antonio-ship-it ``` ### Screenshots

The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. ### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);

- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;

### What product do you use?

AdGuard for iOS

AdGuard gets detected on a website

Safari

AdGuard Japanese filter

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.

</details>

The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973
